items.t: 한국치안산업진흥협회 창립총회 개최…초대 회장에 조현민 한진 사장
items.d: 한국치안산업진흥협회가 창립총회를 열고 국내 치안산업의 체계적인 육성과 경쟁력 강화를 위한 첫발을 내디뎠다. 한국치안산업진흥협회는 지난 15일 오전 11시 스탠포드호텔서울에서 창립총회를 개최했다. 이날 총회에는 한진 조현민 사장을 비롯해 박희찬 에이션패션 대표이사와 배성준 네이버클라우드 전무, 김홍일 케이유니콘인베스트먼트 대표, 이상택 메쎄이상 부사장, 박광영 숭실대학교 교수 등 치안산업계와 학계, 연구기관 관계자들이 참석했다. 총회에서는 △설립
items.fullText: 경제 중기·벤처 한국치안산업진흥협회 창립총회 개최…초대 회장에 조현민 한진 사장 발행일 : 2026-09-16 10:32 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 치안산업 육성·기술사업화·수출 지원 구심점 마련 산업계·학계·연구기관 참여… 첨단 치안산업 생태계 조성 본격화 한국치안산업진흥협회. 사진=한국치안산업진흥협회 한국치안산업진흥협회가 창립총회를 열고 국내 치안산업의 체계적인 육성과 경쟁력 강화를 위한 첫발을 내디뎠다. 한국치안산업진흥협회는 지난 15일 오전 11시 스탠포드호텔서울에서 창립총회를 개최했다. 이날 총회에는 한진 조현민 사장을 비롯해 박희찬 에이션패션 대표이사와 배성준 네이버클라우드 전무, 김홍일 케이유니콘인베스트먼트 대표, 이상택 메쎄이상 부사장, 박광영 숭실대학교 교수 등 치안산업계와 학계, 연구기관 관계자들이 참석했다. 총회에서는 △설립취지문 채택 △정관 채택 △사업계획 및 예산 승인 △주사무소 소재지 결정 △초대 임원 선임 등 협회 운영을 위한 주요 안건을 심의·의결했다. 협회는 앞으로 치안산업의 체계적인 육성과 산업 생태계 조성을 핵심 목표로 다양한 사업을 추진할 계획이다. 주요 사업은 △치안산업 실태조사 및 정책연구 △공공 치안수요와 민간 첨단기술을 연계한 연구·실증·사업화 지원 △회원사 권익 증진과 국내외 판로 개척 △치안산업 전문인력 양성 △책임 있는 치안기술 활용 문화 조성 등이다. 특히 인공지능(AI), 로보틱스, 지능형 CCTV, 사이버보안 등 첨단기술이 치안 현장에 빠르게 도입되고 있는 가운데, 경찰과 기업, 대학, 연구기관을 연결하는 산·학·연 협력 플랫폼 역할을 강화할 방침이다. 조현민 초대 회장은 취임사를 통해 “국민이 누리는 평온한 일상을 지키기 위해서는 예측하기 어려운 다양한 위협에 선제적으로 대비해야 하며, 이를 위해 치안 현장의 역량과 첨단기술·산업의 뒷받침이 함께 필요하다”고 강조했다. 이어 “협회가 공공의 치안 역량과 민간의 혁신기술을 연결하는 가교가 돼 치안기술의 연구·개발과 전문인력 양성, 제도적 지원, 글로벌 시장 진출까지 아우르는 산업 생태계를 조성하고 대한민국 치안산업의 경쟁력을 높이는 데 힘쓰겠다”고 밝혔다. 한국치안산업진흥협회는 향후 치안산업 관련 기업과 전문가, 대학, 연구기관 간 협력을 확대하고 국내 우수 치안기술의 연구개발과 실증, 사업화 및 해외시장 진출을 지원하는 구심점 역할을 수행할 계획이다. 이원지 기자 news21g@etnews.com

items.fullText: ‘Now We Can Know Everything and Do Anything,’ Jensen Huang Says at Dreamforce At Dreamforce, Salesforce and NVIDIA announced Koa, a CRM reasoning model for Agentforce, post-trained from Nemotron on 27 years of Salesforce CRM intelligence — and running entirely within Salesforce’s own infrastructure. September 15, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Know everything. Do anything. That was the message NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang brought to Salesforce Dreamforce Tuesday, joining CEO Marc Benioff onstage in an appearance that coincided with the announcement of Koa — Salesforce’s first CRM reasoning model, built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super. Huang didn’t just take the stage. He walked into the crowd — threading through the audience at Moscone Center, mic in hand, with Benioff alongside. “We’re all following you, bro,” Benioff told Huang at one point, drawing applause. “With electricity, we could power everything,” Huang said, tracing the arc of industrial revolutions. “With the internet, you can find anything. And now, with artificial intelligence as an infrastructure layer across the planet, we can know everything and do anything.” That arc led directly to the announcement. Salesforce’s first reasoning model was built by post-training NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on a proprietary synthetic dataset drawn from nearly three decades of enterprise CRM deployments. AI Safety When Benioff asked Huang about AI safety, Huang was direct. “Safety is paramount in a lot of ways. It’s job one,” Huang said. “However, safety is an engineering problem. We’re developing computing systems after all … If you build a product or a service and you’re not confident in its functionality, capability or safety, then don’t release it.” He reiterated that innovation and leadership should coincide with safety and security . “Innovation, speed and safe products — it’s a false choice,” Huang said. “You could definitely have both at the

items.t: Nvidia’s Huang Says AI Industry Doesn’t Need Any New Laws
items.d: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang dismissed the need for new artificial intelligence security regulations on Tuesday, arguing that market forces will help companies safely innovate.

items.t: Anthropic, Salesforce CEOs Say Companies Need Help Using AI
items.d: Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei and Salesforce Inc. CEO Marc Benioff said companies have just begun taking advantage of artificial intelligence tools and need more help to gain the greatest benefits for their businesses.

September 10, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Gear up: The latest PC games and major updates are ready to play on GeForce NOW this week. WARDOGS drops onto the cloud at early-access launch, alongside the Valheim 1.0 Deep North update and Bus Simulator 27 — part of nine new titles joining the cloud. The newest PC releases can demand serious hardware, storage space and upgrade budgets. GeForce NOW puts GeForce RTX-powered performance in the cloud, so members can jump into the newest titles across supported devices without needing expensive PC upgrades to keep up. From a 100-player tactical firefight to a frozen Viking frontier and a growing bus empire, every adventure is ready when members are — no downloads or storage management required. Who Let the ‘WARDOGS’ Out? Take on the Control Zone: WARDOGS launches on GeForce NOW today, bringing BULKHEAD’s large-scale tactical first-person shooter to the cloud at early-access launch. Up to 100 players across three teams battle to control randomized zones in a large-scale military sandbox, where tactical gunplay, combined-arms combat, building and destruction can change the course of a match. There’s no single route to victory. Outfit a loadout, coordinate a squad, fortify a strategic position or take the fight to the enemy in vehicles. Every team play action earns cash, giving players more ways to invest in gear and vehicles that can turn the tide. Ultimate members can stream the fight with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud for a tactical advantage. Pick up the battle across supported devices without waiting on a huge game install or clearing local storage first. items.fullText: GeForce NOW Gives Gamers More Ways to Play at Gamescom 2026 Dive into the latest announcements from Gamescom and catch ’Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2,’ coming to the cloud this week as part of 13 new games. August 27, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA’s Gamescom announcements are revealing what’s next for GeForce NOW , with new ways to play, more supported devices and platforms, and even more big PC games headed to the cloud. New NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 technology controls give members more ways to fine-tune gameplay, while expanded support for new Steam devices, GOG single sign-on, Firefox browser support and more Amazon Fire TV devices continue broadening where and how GeForce RTX-powered PC gaming can be enjoyed. Gamescom is also bringing a blockbuster lineup of PC games to GeForce NOW. CONTROL Resonant , Gears of War: E-Day , Onimusha: Way of the Sword , The Blood of Dawnwalker and STAR WARS Zero Company are all coming to the cloud at launch. For a limited time, members can also get CONTROL Resonant with the purchase of a 12-month GeForce NOW Ultimate membership . The Gamescom extras don’t stop there. To celebrate, GeForce NOW is giving away more than 40 prizes in our Community Giveaway — including gaming hardware and GeForce NOW Ultimate memberships. There’s even more fun to come. Check out the list of 13 games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Next-Level Cloud Gaming More ways to choose how to play. This fall, GeForce NOW is introducing new NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls in the cloud, giving Ultimate members more choice over how supported games look and perform, even without the latest hardware.
